method: manual review of complete implementation diff; no subagents
checked: first-ready enqueue is once per task; requeue does not add work
claim debits source queue and credits actual execution; completion fractions sum to one logical block
signed per-writer watermarks avoid losing remote debit or counting own history twice
views survive producer boundaries; snapshot readers make one attempt only
actual producer distribution and publisher side have distinct fields
already-completed wiring fast path accumulates actual affinity before releasing producer pins
remote claims use existing unique atomic range primitive and strict/sync/dummy exclusions
no kernel-time field, sampling, new environment switches or behavior macros
control source preservation, isolated builds and separate official Shared
remaining_model_limits: fixed wave prices are policy assumptions, not measured handoff time
resource categories do not fully model MIX interference
BGEMM/PA timings do not establish multiblock pickup benefit
